reason: I read labels and I want proof, and a named independent lab with a report per batch is exactly what I check for. Magnesium bisglycinate with no oxide at 200 mg is a real dose, and at $24.99 the first box is low-risk to try even if I'd rather not swallow two capsules.
objection: Two capsules a day is a chore, and I can't see the actual lab report or reviews yet. A QR code and a claim are not the same as me reading the document and seeing the lab name.
would_change_my_mind: If the sample lab report was not real, or the lab was unnamed or unknown, I would pass.
